page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at top; a full-width heading "EMBLEMA / FIDES PER DILECTIONEM efficax." above a framed engraving; below the engraving a verse epigram in italic lines; at the lower right a catchword "Indif-".

l.i: Si quoties peccant homines sua munera tollat
Iova, erit exiguo tempore nulla fides.
ALMA Fides, Dilectio, Spes, Prudentia, lustum,
Ætherei flatus sunt bona dona Dei.

page.notes: The engraving shows two standing figures (one with a cross, one holding a child) reaching toward a heart, with a dove above in rays of light, a flaming sun, and a balance scale below. The epigram's second line reads "Iova" as printed, likely for "Iova" (Iova = Iova/Iova); the letter forms are uncertain. The heading word "efficax." is set in smaller italic beneath the main title.
